It means the world to us to see people connecting with what we’ve created - and we want to make it easier than ever for more of you to join in. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45036498/b63559d104e62894322827c6b3372bb75a3cb510.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]HYPERxFANTASY is a full-length narrative action RPG (8–12 hours on first playthrough) that blends: [/p][list][*][p][b]Gliding exploration[/b] across vast dystopian landscapes [/p][/*][*][p][b]Deliberate sword combat[/b] against wretches, voidspawn, and corrupted sentinels[/p][/*][*][p][b]Branching dialogues and choices[/b] that shape your path [/p][/*][*][p][b]Meta twists, rhythm challenges, and multiple endings[/b] [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45036498/6cc044c2160bc837589a9bbd015ea94019aef660.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]With strong reviews and a limited-time launch discount on top of the new lower price, now is the perfect time to jump in. notes.title: The Wait is Over - HYPERxFANTASY is Available Now!
notes.notes: [p align="start"]From the bottom of our hearts, thank you. Thank you for following this journey with us, for wishlisting, and for believing in the strange, genre-bending world we've poured so much into. We truly can't believe we've made it to this point, and it's all because of your support.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]For those of you just joining the dream, you're stepping into a world where things are not as they seem. A death cult tells you to lead souls to "Ascension," but you'll quickly discover it’s a scam. The game’s creator, Surcutt-P, is actually trapped inside his own creation, fighting for control against a overpowered Arch-Executer who is twisting the story as you play. Expect a journey inspired by our love for games like [i]NieR:Automata[/i] and [i]The Stanley Parable[/i], blending everything from fast-paced gliding and intentional sword combat to rhythm games and point-and-click sections.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]This launch is a huge moment for us, but it’s not the end of the road - it’s the beginning of a new chapter, together. We’re watching everything closely and are committed to making this experience the best it can possibly be. Your feedback is absolutely critical to that mission.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]If you run into any issues, have amazing ideas, or just want to share your experience, please, please join our [url="https://discord.com/invite/HCYcAyN6nE"]official Discord server[/url]. We’ll be active there, reading every single comment, helping with any potential problems, and just hanging out with you all. We genuinely want to hear what you think.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]To give you a clearer picture of what’s next, we’re already hard at work putting together a [b]post-launch roadmap[/b]. This will outline our plans for future updates, tweaks, and maybe a few surprises. We’re excited to share that with you very soon.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]Thank you again for being a part of this. We poured our souls into this world, and we can't wait to see how you navigate its twists and turns.[/p][p align="start"][/p][p]See you in HYPERxFANTASY![/p]

It helps a lot![/p][p align="start"]Thanks, and see you in HYPERxFANTASY![/p]

notes.title: New X0-03 Demo for ENDIX Festival
notes.notes:
[b]The updated HYPERxFANTASY demo X0-03 is now live for the ENDIX Festival, offering around 30 minutes of new gameplay.[/b]

This build adds fresh scenes, improved performance, and a few moments we won’t spell out—but you’ll know them when they hit.

[h2]What to Expect[/h2]
You’ll get very close to Enris while trying to pull her from the edge of the Singularity tide. It’s a sharp moment—part desperation, part instinct. Maybe even heroic.

You’ll also meet the Guide.
You’ll hate him. He’s unbearable.

[h2]Performance Upgrades[/h2]
Technical specialist Nivrel went deep into the code, resulting in:

[list]
[*]Reduced build size
[*]Lower GPU load
[*]Smoother scene transitions
[/list]

[h2]Steam Page Takeover[/h2]
Surcutt-P replaced every screenshot and added his own captions. We tried to argue. He didn’t care. What’s up now is exactly what he wanted.

[h2]IGN Trailer Drop[/h2]
Our trailer is now on the sacred ground of the [url=https://youtu.be/GQFPUB-5pwA?feature=shared]IGN YouTube channel[/url].

Some viewers noticed a familiar-looking, living, balding figure in the middle of it all. All characters in HYPERxFANTASY are fictional. Any resemblance is coincidental.

[h2]Praise the ENDIX[/h2]
We’re live at the [url=https://endix-expo.com]ENDIX FESTIVAL[/url].

Explore booths. Play other games. Get lost in something good—including us.

[h2]Don’t Forget Our Discord[/h2]
If you haven’t yet, [url=https://discord.com/invite/HCYcAyN6nE]join our Discord[/url]. Share your experience. Drop feedback. Scream into the void.

See you in HYPERxFANTASY.

notes.title: HYPERxFANTASY Demo Fixes + Player Reactions & What’s Next
notes.notes:
[h1]HYPERxFANTASY Demo Update – Player Reactions, Fixes & What’s Next[/h1]
Dreamers, we hear you! Your excitement for the demo has been incredible, and we couldn’t be more grateful for the energy you’ve brought into this world. Today, we’re rolling out an update with improvements, fixes, and a few steps toward making HYPERxFANTASY even better.

[h3]New Feature: Settings (WIP)[/h3]
You asked, and we’re working on it! The new Settings menu is here, with more customization options coming soon. It’s a small step, but an important one.

[h3]Bug Fixes & Optimizations[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed the "Stuck after starting New Game" issue on low-spec PCs.
[*] Fixed the "Gets frozen right at the beginning" bug.
[*] We’re continuing to optimize performance, making sure the experience runs smoother for everyone.
[/list]
[h3]Voice Over Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]  Tweaked and improved voiceovers in the intro section
[/list]
[h3]Your awsome reactions[/h3]
Here are the highlights of what you guys have said about HYPERxFANTASY Demo:

[i]"So I just tried the demo... AND WHAT THE HELL WAS THAT, AND WHEN CAN I GET MORE?"[/i]

[i]"Loved the demo! It's stylish, random, fresh, and above all intriguing! I look forward to what you cook up with HYPERxFANTASY in the future."[/i]

[i]"…and let the creator(s) know that they are killing it with the vibes from the demo. You'll easily win over any fan of NieR (duh) who likes indie games."[/i]


[h3]How Surcutt-P reacts to your feedback[/h3]

We’ve been keeping an eye on the Steam discussions, and your feedback has blown us away. When Surcutt-P read your reactions, he was in the middle of... well, doing something important. But your feedback somehow caught his attention, and for once, he didn’t just grunt and ignore everything.

After a long pause, he finally said, “Hmm... alright, that wasn’t the worst thing I’ve heard today.”


[h3]Don't forget about our discord[/h3]

If you didn't do that already, [url=https://discord.com/invite/HCYcAyN6nE]join our discord[/url] and discuss your experience with others or leave us a feedback!

See you in HYPERxFANTASY!

notes.title: The HYPERxFANTASY Demo is Live!
notes.notes:
The world of HYPERxFANTASY awaits—and to mark this moment, we’re releasing a brand-new demo trailer. Get a glimpse of the madness, the mysteries, and the chaos that lie ahead.


Watch the official demo trailer now, then dive into the experience of HYPERxFANTASY!

https://www.youtube.com/embed/pLYYplcKIIs?si=RC-lyGAMHJ-GxdiQ

[h3]DEMO OVERVIEW[/h3]

In your first moments, you’ll meet Surcutt-P, the enigmatic architect of the program. He’ll explain the demo’s limitations—and why following the Arch-Executor’s orders is a matter of life and death. Consider this your invitation to explore the unknown.


Next, a rhythm minigame awaits, where you'll help a lost soul fulfill its final wish before it departs into the digital afterlife. A simple task… or is it?


You'll also encounter Enris, a figure who may seem distant but hides a warm, caring heart. Together, you'll navigate the sprawling, concrete corridors of the Cortex, a megastructure filled with secrets waiting to be uncovered.


Along the way, you'll be accompanied by Todd, a small, baby-shaped flying robot with an oddly cheerful demeanor. Todd serves as your guide, offering cryptic hints, questionable wisdom, and just enough direction to keep you from losing yourself entirely in the madness.


And for those who want more—at the end of the demo, an optional open section awaits, letting you explore a vast brutalist megastructure on your glider. This content is extra, experimental, and subject to change, but it offers a tantalizing glimpse of what the full game might hold.


The adventure begins now. Try the demo on [url=https://hyperxfantasy.com/Steam]Steam[/url], and join us in [url=https://discord.com/invite/HCYcAyN6nE]Discord[/url] to share your thoughts, ask questions, and connect with fellow Dreamers.


See you in HYPERxFANTASY!

notes.title: Demo Will Be Released with Steam Next Fest
notes.notes:
Hello, Dreamer. The HYPERxFANTASY demo will be released during Steam Next Fest on February 24th, 2025, and we're excited to welcome you into our world.

In the first moments, you'll meet Surcutt-P, the game’s architect. He’ll explain the demo’s limitations—and why following the Arch-Executor’s orders is a matter of life and death. Consider it your invitation to dive a bit deeper into our surreal dreamscape.

Next, you'll jump into a rhythm minigame where your task is to help a lost soul fulfill its final wish before it drifts into the digital afterlife. It’s a simple sequence that hints at the mysteries ahead.

You'll also cross paths with Enris—a character who may seem a bit cold at first, but who hides a warm, caring heart. Together, you and Enris will explore the sprawling, concrete corridors of the Cortex, a megastructure full of secrets waiting to be discovered.

Move freely with your glider and try your hand at melee combat as you journey through our world.

More details will be shared with the demo release. We can’t wait to hear your thoughts—join our Discord on launch day to share your impressions, ask questions, and connect with fellow Dreamers.

See you in HYPERxFANTASY!

notes.title: DEMO Gameplay: HYPERxFANTASY
notes.notes:
Join us for a captivating stream showcasing HYPERxFANTASY, an experimental narrative RPG set in a haunting brutalist underworld on the cusp of digital ascension. This demo gameplay offers an exciting glimpse into the game’s innovative features: glider exploration, tension-filled swordplay, and branching narrative mechanics that defy traditional storytelling.

In this surreal journey as the Dreamer, navigate an endless megastructure, encounter mysterious characters, and uncover the enigmatic conspiracy at the heart of the Singularity. With its striking visuals and atmospheric themes inspired by sci-fi masterpieces like Blade Runner and NieR: Automata, HYPERxFANTASY invites you to reflect on evolution, transhumanism, and the future of identity.

Please note: This stream features pre-release demo footage. Some elements may change in the final game.
